work.projectDescription:
User: Young student founders seeking a structured roadmap for their social impact projects.
Purpose: To generate a personalized milestone path and surface matched opportunities based on the user's project stage, impact area, and weekly time constraints.
Smallest working result: An interactive Babylon.js 3D path where user inputs dynamically adjust pacing and clicking any step opens a GUI card with tailored tasks and matched opportunities.
What I will contribute: Building this solo; web-based application end-to end building, using Visual Studio Code, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Babylon.js; handling data modeling, pacing logic engine, and 3D UI.
work.engine: Visual Studio Code / Babylon.js / HTML, CSS, JavaScript
